user.title: HA Rebrand
user.description: Customize the loading and login screens. Settings apply to new browser loads. See the README for local PNG setup.

data_description.enabled: Turn off to restore stock branding after reloading your browser.
data_description.brand_name: Loading text and browser tab title. Use 1 to 80 printable English characters.
data_description.hide_foundation: Hide the foundation logo and attribution on the initial loading screen.
data_description.logo_light: Optional PNG basename in /config/ha_rebrand_local, for example logo.png. Leave blank for the stock logo.
data_description.logo_dark: Optional PNG for the browser or operating system dark color scheme.
data_description.favicon: Optional PNG basename for the browser tab icon.
data_description.logo_width: Custom logo width in pixels (96 to 800). Defaults to 320; proportions are preserved and small screens scale it down.
data_description.login_enabled: Customize only the login page logo and welcome heading. Turn off to use the stock login page.
data_description.login_heading: Defaults to Welcome. Leave blank to keep Home Assistant's English welcome message. Up to 80 printable English characters.
data_description.login_logo_light: Optional PNG basename in /config/ha_rebrand_local. Leave both login logo fields blank to reuse your loading logos.
data_description.login_logo_dark: Optional dark-mode login PNG. If you set only one login logo, it is used in both modes.
data_description.login_logo_width: Width in pixels, from 96 to 800. Defaults to 320; the logo is limited by the login column and viewport.
data_description.pwa_enabled: Use your brand name and app icon in HA's web app manifest. Reinstall existing shortcuts to refresh Android's saved splash and icon.
data_description.pwa_icon: Optional local PNG basename. Blank uses the favicon, then your loading logo. A square, high-resolution image is recommended.

error.invalid_asset: Cannot read a valid local PNG. Check the directory and filename. Use a static PNG up to 2 MiB and 2048 pixels per dimension; paths, URLs and symlinks are not allowed.
error.invalid_name: Enter 1 to 80 printable English characters without line breaks.
error.invalid_width: Enter a whole number between 96 and 800 pixels.
error.invalid_heading: Enter up to 80 printable English characters without line breaks, or leave blank.
